traits.name: Twisting Tail
traits.text: ⬲ When a creature within 10 feet uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using, the dragon can use their reaction to make a tail Strike at the creature with a –2 penalty. If it hits, the creature stops moving in the square it was in when the dragon used this reaction.

traits.name: Stride
traits.text: ⬻ 30 feet, or fly 80 feet, or swim 20 feet

traits.name: Melee Strike
traits.text: ⬻ (poison); Damage 2d8+4 (2d8+4) piercing plus 1d4 (1d4) poison Melee Strike ⬻ claw +14 (agile), Damage 2d6+4 (2d6+4) slashing Melee Strike ⬻ tail +12 (reach 10 feet), Damage 1d8+4 (1d8+4) bludgeoning Melee Strike ⬻ horn +12, Damage 1d12+4 (1d12+4) bludgeoning

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (arcane, evocation, poison); The dragon breathes a toxic cloud that deals 5d6 (5d6) poison damage in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 24 basic Reflex save. The dragon can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Draconic Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

traits.name: Draconic Momentum
traits.text: When the dragon gets a critical success on a Strike, they recharge their Breath Weapon.
